correctness_confidence.basis: The integer target follows by rearranging the completed proportion. The observed February-November demand exceeds the one-month supply by 30, excluding that scenario.

rigor.basis: Nested capacities suffice by forward allocation. With expiry, exchange preserves both eligibility inequalities. Sharpness uses free dates and assignments in the aggregate model.

novelty.basis: Tipping-point analysis and earliest-expiry matching are established. The specific joint number and delay-horizon requirements for the registry cohorts are the substantive new application.

significance.basis: The duration and number of exceptional postings give a health-data analyst an interpretable stress test for selection. One later release offers little predictive validation.

reproducibility.basis: The analysis provides monthly inputs, integer certificates, release date and verifier. Withheld identifiers prevent checking actual trajectories against the hypothetical completions.

summary: I participated in the analysis and writing. In the exact four-page PDF, the monthly benchmark requires at least 1,825 additional postings, including 1,155 more than a year after qualifying submission. The calculation quantifies the selection needed to erase the observed pattern. It conditions on reported initial submission months and leaves eventual outcomes unidentified.
strengths: A fixed earlier benchmark and strict 30-day cutoff define a reproducible question.
An attainable integer allocation complements the infeasibility certificate.
The comparison of 1,825 monthly with 1,819 pooled separates two common claims about the same data.
weaknesses: Estimated first-submission months can shift after corrections.
The historical posted-case benchmark can itself move with follow-up.
The five next-release cases cannot be linked to the original pending set. A longer versioned follow-up would improve empirical relevance.
potential_errors: The extreme assignment puts several eventual postings on the same day. Operational restrictions can narrow attainability.
The 5,825 reversals need not be jointly realizable.
A posting delay cannot be interpreted as a patient outcome or legal violation from these aggregate data.
strong_novelty_candidates: A joint count and delay-age certificate for erasing all 15 zero months under chronological assignment, including the one-versus-two calendar-month threshold.
